units.title: Transformations and inverses
units.why: Transformations help learners predict graph behaviour without plotting every point.
principles: an inverse reverses input and output when the relation is one-to-one
examples: y=(x-2)^2+1 shifts y=x² right 2 and up 1
misconceptions: reading f(x-p) as a left shift
assuming every relation has a function inverse
practice: What does a reflection in x-axis do?
Why swap x and y for an inverse?

videoPackage.title: Transforming function graphs
videoPackage.transcript: We start with a parent graph, apply one transformation at a time, and verify inverse pairs by composing the mappings.
